findings.detail: Seven of the 28 required mutation cells are absent from the implementation. Missing inbound: row 11 (delete issue link — test_inbound_link_round_trips only asserts the add, not the removal), row 12 (set sub-task parent), row 13 (clear parent). Missing outbound: row 9 (clear assignee — not in _OUTBOUND_CELLS and no standalone test), row 11 (delete link — test_outbound_link_round_trips docstring says 'Rows 10-11' but only asserts the add at line 637), row 13 (clear parent), row 14 (delete ticket). The _INBOUND_CELLS list has 8 entries (rows 02-09) and _OUTBOUND_CELLS has 6 entries (rows 02-08 minus 06 which is a standalone). The standalone tests cover rows 1, 10, 12 (epic case only), and 14 for each direction, but rows 11, 12 (sub-task), and 13 inbound and rows 9, 11, 13, 14 outbound have no implementation.
